rain.scene: Cold. Dense sheets of white dots falling all around you, a small figure in an oversized hunting jacket walking through them, shoulders hunched.

puddle.scene: Defeat. The camera at the waterline of a mud puddle. A bundle of baby clothes half sunk in it, rings of dots spreading out from where it fell, and her wavering reflection upside down in the water.

glow.scene: Longing. From the dark lane, an open kitchen door: the bakery's ovens inside, and a fan of dense bright dots spilling out across the mud, with rain falling through the light.

bread.scene: Kindness. A girl slumped at the base of an apple tree, a pig pen and pig beside her, two loaves arcing through the air toward her. The burned crusts are the densest dots in the scene.

pig.scene: Cruelty and courage. Close at the trough: chunks of burned bread tumbling into it and the pig eating, while behind the fence a boy, back turned, tears at the loaves.

fluffy.scene: Relief. Lying on your back on the school yard grass, looking up: soft, slow clouds of dots drifting overhead in warm air.

dandelion.scene: Hope. A single dandelion head close up, its seeds lifting off one by one and drifting past and around you, up into the dark.
